💼 CEO LANE (Command Hub) • Never reads code or edits files • Issues 100% verbatim contracts • Keeps repo clean (git status == 0) • Async standby + 10-min timer

g.data-label: 🗺️ 2. STRATEGIC PLANNER • Splits Report into full Plan (Milestones, Epics, Leaf Tasks, 4 Ledgers)
🧭 3. ENGINEER LANE • Contextual pre-flight / Touch-Map lock • Resolves FAST BLOCK (never blocks back) • Commits & hands off to CEO -> HARD STOP

text.tspan: • Commits & hands off to CEO -> HARD STOP

g.data-label: 💻 4. CODER LANE • Implements 100% Touch-Map • Builds via repository standard script • Logs to evidence.md / benchmark.md • Clean commit & handoff -> HARD STOP
🧪 5. QA LANE • Runs standard build script to fresh .exe • Tests live UX (Computer Use, NO Playwright) • Logs evidence, commits & handoff -> HARD STOP
